title: [Textualize/rich] Fix issue #4210: repair broken Sphinx cross-references
description:
Fix GitHub issue #4210 in Textualize/rich:
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/issues/4210

Repo: https://github.com/Textualize/rich

Deliver a focused code/documentation change that repairs the three broken Sphinx cross-references verified in issue #4210, with targeted documentation validation.

Required deliverables:
- A real repository change, not analysis only.
- An upstream PR against Textualize/rich linked to issue #4210.
- Testing or documentation-build notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.
- The upstream PR body or linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit the change plus the upstream PR.

Concrete PR evidence requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and 1b212a20-d349-468c-8988-54427c2c49f8 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/1b212a20-d349-468c-8988-54427c2c49f8 in the upstream PR body or linked issue comment.
